core.name: document.draw
core.title: Draw a picture
core.description: Creates or edits a native SVG drawing in the active document: movable, editable figures, a spatial sketch or a brush painting. Separate from Mermaid: a Mermaid flowchart is a fence in the Markdown source, inserted with document.apply_edits and rendered in the document. Read the drawing for recipe_handle. Change a drawing dial with shapes.set; a background kind or effect preset alone takes its starting values. Change an object with an operation. A complete recipe replaces the inspected recipe, including strokes and fonts, and uses the same open-canvas hand-off as a patch. An imported SVG without a Rapier recipe is edited node by node: read it for its node tree, then send svg_handle with node_edits. With contribution, the picture is staged with your words under that name for the person to keep or drop together; a patch to the drawing the person has open takes no contribution (it is refused draw_session_open), so it goes without one and lands at once.

open.description: Open the committed drawing in the attached editor; true by default. Human navigation takes priority.

replay.description: Show the accepted turn through Draw replay; true by default. This never changes material simulation time.

recipe.description: A complete inspected drawing recipe. With recipe_handle it replaces canvas, paper, strokes and fonts. Redacted paint raster markers retain their original ids. Exclusive with shapes and figures.

figures.description: Figures use kind, not type. Example: [{"kind":"rect","id":"start","label":"Start"},{"kind":"rect","id":"end","label":"Finish"},{"kind":"arrow","from":"start","to":"end"}]. Omit x, y, w and h for automatic layout. Figures create a new drawing; on an existing or open drawing, send the same figures in shapes.add or shapes.replace. Paint with real brushes: {"kind":"paint","seed":1,"strokes":[{"brush":"rapier/oil","colour":"#2255cc","size":50,"points":[[x,y,pressure],...]}]}. Water uses {"kind":"paint","mode":"water","seed":1,"paper":"cold-press","actions":[{"kind":"stroke","brush":"water/round","pigment":"ultramarine","paths":[[[10,10,0.7,0],[20,15,0.5,6]]]}]}; get_context.paint lists every brush; rapier.guide with topic paint lists the complete pigment palette, paper settings, controls and actions. Water path points are [x,y,pressure,tick], with integer ticks at 60 per second. Text uses an action {"kind":"text","text":"Hi","at":[10,10],"textSize":16}; Trace uses {"kind":"trace","shapeId":"outline"} from the inspected drawing. Both take brush, pigment and controls. Paint size is 0-100; load and water 0-1; angle 0-179 degrees; follow and erase are booleans. Point samples use x and y in drawing units, with optional pressure 0-1. In shapes.replace, a paint figure names the inspected layer id and edits its existing material and transform.

direction.description: The direction of automatic figure layout on create or shapes.add; down by default.

background.description: The canvas background as a recipe carries it, {kind, ...}; send the kind alone to take the person's starting values for every number you leave out. null removes it.

paper.description: The canvas colour; null returns it to automatic.

effect.description: The copy machine on the whole drawing, {preset} alone is a whole effect. null removes it.

mcp.description: Points at an inspected passage, drawing object, applied change or pending review change with a few words, without editing the document. Supply exactly one of context_handle or change_id. The pointer lasts 1 to 30 seconds and clears at your next change or the person's tap; the receipt says shown, deferred or expired.

mcp.name: document.export
mcp.title: Export the document
mcp.description: Creates a file link, up to 8 MiB: markdown is the exact source; html is the offline editor with its source inside; txt is the document's words as plain text; page is a standalone rendered web page; docx is Word; pdf carries raster pages, searchable text and the attached source. An open editor builds Word and PDF without a tap. The receipt states what each format keeps. With a connected host the link needs its connection; without one the link is its own grant. The stored file lasts up to 24 hours within the workspace lifetime.

mcp.name: document.draw
mcp.title: Draw a picture
mcp.description: Creates or edits a native SVG drawing in the active document: movable, editable figures, a spatial sketch or a brush painting. Separate from Mermaid: a Mermaid flowchart is a fence in the Markdown source, inserted with document.apply_edits and rendered in the document. Read the drawing for recipe_handle. Change a drawing dial with shapes.set; a background kind or effect preset alone takes its starting values. Change an object with an operation. A complete recipe replaces the inspected recipe, including strokes and fonts, and uses the same open-canvas hand-off as a patch. An imported SVG without a Rapier recipe is edited node by node: read it for its node tree, then send svg_handle with node_edits. With contribution, the picture is staged with your words under that name for the person to keep or drop together; a patch to the drawing the person has open takes no contribution (it is refused draw_session_open), so it goes without one and lands at once.

document.description: The document value rapier.open returned. With a connected host it names the workspace and the connection is the authority; without one it is the workspace's whole authority, so keep it private.

open.description: Open the committed drawing in the attached editor; true by default. Human navigation takes priority.

replay.description: Show the accepted turn through Draw replay; true by default. This never changes material simulation time.

recipe.description: A complete inspected drawing recipe. With recipe_handle it replaces canvas, paper, strokes and fonts. Redacted paint raster markers retain their original ids. Exclusive with shapes and figures.

figures.description: Figures use kind, not type. Example: [{"kind":"rect","id":"start","label":"Start"},{"kind":"rect","id":"end","label":"Finish"},{"kind":"arrow","from":"start","to":"end"}]. Omit x, y, w and h for automatic layout. Figures create a new drawing; on an existing or open drawing, send the same figures in shapes.add or shapes.replace. Paint with real brushes: {"kind":"paint","seed":1,"strokes":[{"brush":"rapier/oil","colour":"#2255cc","size":50,"points":[[x,y,pressure],...]}]}. Water uses {"kind":"paint","mode":"water","seed":1,"paper":"cold-press","actions":[{"kind":"stroke","brush":"water/round","pigment":"ultramarine","paths":[[[10,10,0.7,0],[20,15,0.5,6]]]}]}; get_context.paint lists every brush; rapier.guide with topic paint lists the complete pigment palette, paper settings, controls and actions. Water path points are [x,y,pressure,tick], with integer ticks at 60 per second. Text uses an action {"kind":"text","text":"Hi","at":[10,10],"textSize":16}; Trace uses {"kind":"trace","shapeId":"outline"} from the inspected drawing. Both take brush, pigment and controls. Paint size is 0-100; load and water 0-1; angle 0-179 degrees; follow and erase are booleans. Point samples use x and y in drawing units, with optional pressure 0-1. In shapes.replace, a paint figure names the inspected layer id and edits its existing material and transform.

direction.description: The direction of automatic figure layout on create or shapes.add; down by default.

background.description: The canvas background as a recipe carries it, {kind, ...}; send the kind alone to take the person's starting values for every number you leave out. null removes it.

paper.description: The canvas colour; null returns it to automatic.

effect.description: The copy machine on the whole drawing, {preset} alone is a whole effect. null removes it.

canvas.description: The canvas size in drawing units.

frame.description: The rectangle the picture is saved as; null follows the ink.

set.description: The drawing's own settings, each replacing the one it names and landing on an open drawing as one Undo step: background, paper, effect, canvas, frame, light, smooth and nib.

replace.description: Complete replacement shapes, each by its id. Copy the inspected shape and change only the intended fields; id and label alone are not a shape. A kind:paint figure with id and strokes paints into that existing Paint layer. Water uses id, mode:water and actions. Both preserve the inspected material and transform.

shapes.description: A patch to an existing drawing. On a drawing the person has open it lands at once, or the moment their hand leaves the canvas; their own work is kept.

operations.description: Edits on inspected object ids, applied in order through the same Draw owner as the person. Shapes and operations can be edited while Draw is open. Omitted properties are retained; null removes an optional override.

dash.description: The dash; null selects a solid line.

nib.description: The Width control, in native nib units.

step.description: The step number above the label inside a box; null removes it.

mcp.name: rapier.open
mcp.title: Open a shared editable document
mcp.description: Creates a shared workspace from text or a host file, or resumes one by its document value. Use for documents the person and assistant will edit together: drafts, plans, guides, drawings and reviewed revisions. Returns editor_url, the live editor for the person's browser; when that browser shows a four-letter code, pair it with document.pair_browser. Native SVG drawings use document.draw; Mermaid stays in Markdown through document.apply_edits. document.export keeps an independent Markdown file or offline editor. Workspaces expire after 30 idle days.
